description_en: Compares the configurations of two published playbook versions
description_zh: 用于比较发布的两个版本的剧本配置信息
name: ComparePlaybooks

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook.

Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
剧本的UUID。
调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the first published version for comparison.

To obtain the UUID of a historical version, call the [DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~) operation. The system automatically generates a UUID for a new version
parameters.help_zh:
用于比较的第一个发布版本UUID。
历史版本调用[DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~)接口可以获取该参数，新发布版本系统会自动生成
parameters.name: old_playbook_release_id

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the second published version for comparison.

To obtain the UUID of a historical version, call the [DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~) operation. The system automatically generates a UUID for a new version
parameters.help_zh:
用于比较的第二个发布版本UUID。
历史版本调用[DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~)接口可以获取该参数，新发布版本系统会自动生成
parameters.name: new_playbook_release_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Description.description_en: The description of the comparison result
Description.example: The first version adds one node compared to the second version

New.description_en:
Indicates whether the second version used for comparison is a new version.

true: The version is new.

false: The version is not new
New.description_zh:
用于比较的第二个版本，是否为新增版本：

true：表示为新增版本。
false：表示不是新增版本

Same.description_en:
Indicates whether the two versions are identical.

true: Identical.

false: Not identical
Same.description_zh:
两个版本是否相同的标记。
true：相同。
false：不相同

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
